result.markdown: --- format: html: suppress-bibliography: true --- # LDH Assays {.unnumbered} ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # loading packages and functions library(tidyverse) library(kableExtra) library(ggtext) library(scales) library(lme4) library(lmerTest) library(emmeans) library(ggpubr) source("R/LMM_functions.R") ``` ::: ## Data Input ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Load the BOX_PATH environment variable FOLDER_PATH <- Sys.getenv("BOX_PATH") # Define subdirectories within the Box folder dataframes_folder <- file.path(FOLDER_PATH, "dataframes") rawdata_folder <- file.path(FOLDER_PATH, "rawdata/LDH") outputs_folder <- file.path(FOLDER_PATH, "outputs/LDH") if (!dir.exists(outputs_folder)) { dir.create(outputs_folder, recursive = TRUE) } ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Read the provided RDS file dataframeID <- "DatCol" LDH <- readRDS(file.path(dataframes_folder, paste0(dataframeID, "_LDH_HNO.rds"))) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Compute fold change of LDH values at final timepoint relative to initial timepoint for each date/line/nickname group. LDH_FC <- LDH %>% mutate(timepoint = if_else(time == 0, "initial", "final")) %>% # compute avg per group but keep original rows group_by(date, line, nickname, timepoint) %>% mutate(avg_Value = mean(Abs, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>% # pivot the averages wider (one row per date/line/nickname) distinct(date, line, nickname, timepoint, avg_Value) %>% pivot_wider( names_from = timepoint, values_from = avg_Value ) %>% # compute ratio mutate(ratio = final / initial) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Separate dataframes for each plot LDH_FC_hla <- LDH_FC %>% filter(date %in% c("2/6/2025","2/13/2025","2/19/2025","4/8/2025")) %>% droplevels() LDH_FC_Tn <- LDH_FC %>% filter(date %in% c("10/1/2024","10/22/2024")) %>% droplevels() LDH_FC_Other <- LDH_FC %>% filter(date %in% c("4/18/2026", "4/20/2026", "4/21/2026", "4/25/2026", "4/28/2026", "5/5/2026", "5/6/2026")) %>% droplevels() ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Function to create a ggplot with jittered points, emmeans predictions with error bars, and a dashed line at y=1. plot_ldh_function <- function(formated_stats_results, ymin, ymax, title_x = " ", title_y = " ", x_var, y_var, x_labels, fill_var, shape_var, facet_var, fill_colors, shape_leves, fill_title, shape_title) { annot <- formated_stats_results$main %>% filter(sign == "*") %>% mutate(sign = "") plot <- ggplot(data = formated_stats_results$input_data) + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) + geom_jitter( aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = {{ y_var }}, fill = {{ fill_var }}, shape = {{ shape_var }}), size = 4, stroke = 0.01, width = 0.2, color = "white") + geom_point(data = formated_stats_results$predictions, aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = predicted_mean), shape = 3, size = 1) + geom_errorbar(data = formated_stats_results$predictions, aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = predicted_mean, ymin = predicted_lower, ymax = predicted_upper), width = .15) + scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, name = fill_title) + scale_shape_manual(values = shape_leves, name = shape_title) + scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(ymin, ymax)) + guides( fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "white", size = 3, stroke = 2)), shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "black", size = 3, stroke = 2))) + labs(x = title_x, y = title_y) + theme_bw() + theme( panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"), strip.text.x = element_markdown(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"), text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"), axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black") ) if (nrow(annot) > 0) { plot <- plot + stat_pvalue_manual(annot, label = "sign", y.position = ymax, step.increase = -0.04, tip.length = 0.01, bracket.shorten = 0.2, vjust = 0.6, bracket.size = 0.5) } return(plot) } ``` ::: ## Statistical Analysis Fold change between groups was compared using a LMM with colonizing strain as fixed effect and experimental date as a random effect (line was singular, or not part of the experimental design). We analyzed pairwise contrasts comparing only to the uncolonized condition. We then adjusted the p-values for multiple comparisons using the Holm method and created a `sign` annotation column to indicate which comparisons are statistically significant with p<0.05. Vertical brackets represent model-predicted mean values and confidence intervals (± 2 × SEM), back-transformed to the original response scale. ### hla ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Run the mixed model with emmeans contrasts for the hla dataset. stats_results_hla <- mixed_model_with_emmeans( input_data = LDH_FC_hla, response = "ratio", log_response = FALSE, adjust = "holm", fixed_effects = c("nickname"), random_effects1 = "line", random_effects2 = "date" ) stats_formated_hla <- format_stats_results(stats_results_hla) # Filter the contrasts to only include comparisons to the "Uncol" condition. # Pvalues are adjusted using the Holm method only for the contrasts that are being kept and the significance annotation is added accordingly. stats_formated_hla$main <- stats_formated_hla$main %>% filter(condition1 == "Uncol") %>% mutate( p.value.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"), sign = case_when(p.value.adj < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "") ) # Save the stats results saveRDS(stats_formated_hla, file.path(outputs_folder, "stats_results_HNO_LDH_hla.rds")) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Render the results cat("Model Formula:", format(stats_results_hla$model_formula)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Model Formula: ratio ~ nickname + (1 | date) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} kable(stats_formated_hla$random_effects, caption = "Random Effects") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Random Effects |grp |var1 |var2 | vcov| sdcor| proportion|singular | DenDF| F value| Pr(>F)| |:--------|-------:|--------:|-----:|-----:|--------:|---------:| |nickname | 134.487| 67.24352| 2| 9| 10.27046| 0.0047554| ::: ```{.r .cell-code} kable(stats_formated_hla$main select(effect_name, p.value.anova, condition1, condition2, predicted_mean.1, predicted_mean.2, FC, log2FC, p.value, p.value.adj, sign), caption = "Main Contrasts with Predicted Log2FC" ) ``` :::
